column1: The handler now explicitly tracks referenced trip IDs and fetches missing records. Tests cover adjacent trips, entry and active-trip references, and partial results when selected lookups fail.

column3: `buildTripReferences` records missing entry, schedule next/previous, and active-status trip IDs. It fetches those IDs instead of scanning empty placeholder records.
A three-trip block fixture and integration tests verify complete trip references. Failure-injection tests verify that lookup failures retain successful references and return HTTP 200.
